description: The intake and research check (INTAKE-RESEARCH; D-077) and the root-cause and alternatives check (AUDIT-ROOT-CAUSE; D-081): the files a unit or program folder created after each rule carries, and their sections.

intake.alternatives_section.description: The plan section with one `### R<n>` per structural root and its table of alternatives.

intake.audit_sections.description: The `## ` sections the audit file carries, each non-empty (Daniel 29/10 16:26 BRT): the inputs it read and how far our code is from the research's state of the art.

intake.choice_section.description: The plan section with one `R<n> → A<k>: <justification>` line per structural root.

intake.intake_file.description: The INTAKE file of a folder: the adapter from an external request to our understanding.

intake.intake_sections.description: The `## ` sections the intake file carries, each non-empty (compared without case or accents).

intake.program_files.description: A v8 program's files in stage order (D-115), each with the `## ` sections it carries non-empty; a later file needs every earlier one.

intake.research_file.description: The RESEARCH file of a folder: who already solved the intake's real problem and how it fits us.

intake.research_sections.description: The `## ` sections the research file carries, each non-empty (compared without case or accents).

default.name: intake
default.title: intake
default.header: INTAKE (Padrão v6, D-077): translate the external request into our understanding. Complete on its own; it does not tell the research or the audit what to do.

sections.heading: Pedido
sections.comment: The request, literal, with who asked and when. Do not interpret.

sections.heading: Intenção
sections.comment: The real why behind the request.

sections.heading: Contexto
sections.comment: Current state, deadlines, what came before, dependencies.

sections.heading: Regras
sections.comment: D-NNN decisions, premises (P-NN) and Padrão rules that apply.

sections.heading: Problema real
sections.comment: One sentence, plus the metric that says "resolved".

sections.heading: Lacunas
sections.comment: What I do not know and on whom it depends. If only the requester knows, ask before spending effort.

default.name: research
default.title: research
default.header: RESEARCH (Padrão v6, D-077): look outward, starting from the intake's real problem. About one page, ~15 minutes; an obvious reference takes one line. Complete on its own; it raises no questions for the audit.

sections.heading: Quem já resolveu
sections.comment: 3-5 real references: link and what each solves.

sections.heading: Estado da arte
sections.comment: The standard solution, the most advanced one, and what each requires.

sections.heading: Encaixe em nós
sections.comment: Copy directly / adapt / does not fit, with the reason for each.

sections.heading: Escada de ambição
sections.comment: The minimum useful step now (the plan's "Cheapest useful effort") -> the path to the state of the art.

default.name: audit
default.title: audit
default.header: AUDIT (Padrão v7, D-077, D-081): read-only, cheap evidence. Complete on its own; it states causes and never dictates the plan's work.

sections.heading: Entradas
sections.comment: Links to this unit's intake.md and research.md, read as inputs: the real problem and the state of the art. They inform the audit; they do not dictate its questions, which the audit builds on its own.

sections.heading: Findings
sections.comment: Numbered findings, each with its evidence (file:line, command, PR).

sections.heading: Causas raiz
sections.comment:
5 Whys + fishbone, blameless (Padrão v7, D-081). One `### R<n>. <title>` per root cause; several causes are several branches. Each root: `Cadeia de porquês:` with at least three numbered whys (usually ~5), `1. Por que …? …`, down to a STRUCTURAL cause we control (a missing rule, a missing mechanism, a wrong design). "Someone made a mistake" or "a flaky run" is never a stop: ask why the system let it happen. Then `Classe:` with one of: bug local | regra faltando | mecanismo faltando | arquitetura/desenho, and `Evidência:`. State causes only; NO solution here (the plan weighs the alternatives).

### R1. <the cause, in one line>
Cadeia de porquês:
1. Por que <the finding>? <answer, with evidence>
2. Por que <that answer>? <answer>
3. Por que <that answer>? <answer>
Classe: <bug local | regra faltando | mecanismo faltando | arquitetura/desenho>
Evidência: <file:line, command, PR>

sections.heading: Distância do estado da arte
sections.comment: Where our current code stands against the reference in research.md ("Estado da arte"): what we already have, what is missing, which rung of the "Escada de ambição" we are on.

sections.heading: Base defects expected
sections.comment: Known defects of the base this unit will meet, and their owners; "None known" is an answer.

default.name: plan
default.title: plan
default.header: PLAN (Padrão v7, D-077, D-081): reads audit.md's `## Causas raiz` and research.md's `## Escada de ambição`; decides before it executes. The PR description mirrors this file.

sections.heading: Alternativas
sections.comment:
For each root of audit.md whose class is structural (regra faltando, mecanismo faltando, arquitetura/desenho), a `### R<n>` with 2-4 alternatives at different levels: remendo (the symptom) / corrige a classe (every instance of the cause) / redesenho (the state of the art from research.md). A `bug local` needs none. Criteria: resolve a raiz?, custo, reversibilidade, risco, degrau (rung of the escada de ambição).

### R1 <the root, as audit.md names it>
| Alternativa | Nível | Resolve a raiz? | Custo | Reversibilidade | Risco | Degrau |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| A1 <option> | remendo | não: <why> | <minutes, quota> | <how to undo> | <what can go wrong> | 0 |
| A2 <option> | corrige a classe | sim | … | … | … | 1 |
| A3 <option> | redesenho | sim | … | … | … | 3 |

sections.heading: Escolha
sections.comment: One line per structural root: `- R<n> → A<k>: <justification against the criteria>`. A `remendo` is allowed only with the reason and a `Follow-up: <unit, issue or PR that fixes the root>` on that line or the lines under it.

sections.heading: Commits
sections.comment: The commits as a dependency graph (3-8, D-025), each with the files it owns (no file owned by two parallel commits) and which run in parallel.

sections.heading: Premises
sections.comment: `Premises: P-NN, …` or `Premises: none`; each with its blast radius; CRITICAL when its failure changes scope, spends money, touches production or the source of truth.

sections.heading: Tests
sections.comment: The targeted tests per commit and the single final gate.

sections.heading: Base defects expected
sections.comment: Known defects of the base this unit will meet, and their owners; "None known" is an answer.

sections.heading: Cheapest useful effort
sections.lines:
Action: <the most expensive action of the plan>
Cost: <minutes, quota, money>
Requirement: <who needs its result: a person, a role or a lane, never the gate, the train or the tests>
Cheaper rejected: <the cheaper paths considered and why each does not satisfy the requirement>

intake.template_sections.description: The four process templates (docs/process/templates/): per template its title, the comment under the header and each section's heading with its hint comment (or the raw lines of the effort block). scripts/intake-templates renders them; the drift test fails when a committed template differs from the render or misses a section the registry names (D-205).
